title: Identifying Helpers
ques: Who is the person who treats you and gives you medicine when you are feeling sick?

answer.content: A **Doctor** (or a Nurse) is the person who treats you when you are sick.

explanation: This exercise helps students identify key community roles and their functions.

title: Tools of the Trade
ques: A fire engine, a hose, and a ladder are tools used by which community helper?

answer.content: These tools are used by a **Firefighter** to put out fires and rescue people.

explanation: This connects professions with the specific equipment they use, enhancing understanding of how jobs are performed.

title: Respecting Workers
ques: Why is it important to be polite and say 'Thank you' to the person who sweeps the streets and collects the garbage?

answer.content: It is important because they work very hard to keep our city clean and safe for everyone. We should respect all jobs because every helper makes our community a better place to live.

explanation: This focuses on civic duty, empathy, and social respect for all types of labor.
